title: Modern Chinese 1: Spoken
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText: Chinese native speakers from Mainland China and Taiwan are not eligible for this course. Students from a Chinese heritage background, including those from Hong Kong and Macao, must undertake a language proficiency assessment or be given permission by the course convener to enrol in this course.

title: Modern Chinese 1: Written
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText: Chinese native speakers from Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao are not eligible for this course. Students from a Chinese heritage background must undertake a language proficiency assessment or be given permission by the course convener to enrol in this course.

title: Taiwanese (Southern Min)
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText: To enrol in this course, you must have completed CHIN3023, undertake a language proficiency assessment or be given permission by the course convener.

title: Literary Chinese 1
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed a language proficiency assessment or have otherwise received permission from the course convener. The language proficiency assessment demands knowledge equivalent to that acquired through successful completion of CHIN2023 or JPNS2015.

title: Literary Chinese 2
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText:
To enrol in this course you must have completed CHIN2019, undertake a language proficiency assessment or be given permission by the course convener.

Incompatible with CHIN3031 and CHIN6531.

title: Modern Chinese 2: Spoken
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed CHIN1012, undertake a language proficiency assessment or be given permission by the course convener. Native speakers of Chinese are not eligible to enrol in this course.

title: Modern Chinese 2: Written
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed CHIN1013, or undertake a language proficiency assessment or be given permission by the course convener. Native speakers of Chinese are not eligible to enrol in this course.

title: Cantonese 1
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText: To enrol in this course, you must have completed CHIN2017, or CHIN3018, or CHIN3021, or CHIN6521, undertake a language proficiency assessment, or be given permission by the course convener. Cantonese native speakers from Hong Kong, Macao, and the Cantonese-speaking regions of China are not eligible for this course. Students with a Cantonese heritage background must undertake a language proficiency assessment.

title: Cantonese 2
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText:
To enrol in this course you must have completed CHIN2024, CHIN6201, undertake a language proficiency assessment or be given permission by the course convener. Cantonese native speakers from Hong Kong, Macao, and the Cantonese-speaking regions of China are not eligible for this course. Students with a Cantonese heritage background must undertake a language proficiency assessment.

Incompatible with CHIN6202.

title: Advanced Literary Chinese
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have passed CHIN2021 or CHIN3031, completed a language proficiency assessment; or have otherwise received permission from the course convener.

title: Modern Chinese 3
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText:
To enrol in this course you must have completed CHIN2022 and CHIN2023, or undertake a language proficiency assessment, or be given permission by the course convener. Native speakers of Chinese are not eligible to enrol in this course.
Incompatible with CHIN2014.

title: Modern Chinese 4
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText:
To enrol in this course students must have completed CHIN3017 or CHIN2014, or undertaken a language proficiency assessment, or be given permission by the course convener.
Incompatible with CHIN2017 and CHIN3021.

requisiteText: To enrol in this course, you must have completed CHIN2017, CHIN3018, undertake a language proficiency assessment or be given permission by the course convener.

title: Chinese-English Translation

title: Chinese-English Interpreting
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText: To enrol in this course you must have completed at least CHIN3025 or have been permitted entry based on the results of the Chinese language proficiency assessment.
